integrity: Integral proof is self-contained; a standard-library mod-two checker provides independent finite consistency tests but is not a proof of integral primitivity or the all-graphs statement.
scientific_limitations: The no-death statement concerns degree two in clique complexes of line graphs under underlying graph inclusions; it does not extend to arbitrary flag filtrations or higher degrees. Priority may be affected by prior naturality refinements of the known two-skeleton model.
title: The complete integral second-homology support lattice of the Petersen independence complex
